name: P550

images.alt: Yeastar P550 official manufacturer product photograph

summary.en: An on-premises P-Series PBX for a designed office or hotel telephone system.
summary.sw: PBX ya P-Series inayofungwa eneo la mteja kwa mfumo wa simu wa ofisi au hoteli.

value.sw: Watumiaji 50 / hadi simu 25 zinazoendelea kwa pamoja

value.en: SIP trunks; analogue interfaces depend on fitted modules
value.sw: SIP trunk; interface za analogue hutegemea module zilizowekwa

variants: Exact revision, firmware, power accessories and licensing confirmed in quotation

compatibility.en: User and concurrent-call maxima are not included trunks or analogue ports. Verify fitted modules, PBX edition, firmware, licence/subscription and endpoint provisioning. Linkus and hotel/PMS capabilities require the applicable supported configuration; no universal interoperability is promised.
compatibility.sw: Upeo wa watumiaji na simu za pamoja si idadi ya trunk au port za analogue zilizojumuishwa. Hakiki module, edition, firmware, leseni/subscription na provisioning. Linkus na PMS za hoteli hutegemea usanidi unaoungwa mkono; compatibility ya kila kifaa haiahidiwi.

name: TA400 · FXS

images.alt: Yeastar TA400 · FXS official manufacturer product photograph

summary.en: Connect suitable analogue room or office handsets through four FXS ports to a planned IP-PBX installation.
summary.sw: Unganisha simu za analogue za vyumbani au ofisini kupitia port nne za FXS kwenye mfumo wa IP-PBX uliopangwa.

value.sw: Kuendelea na extension za analogue za vyumbani zilizopimwa

variants: Exact revision, firmware, power accessories and licensing confirmed in quotation

compatibility.en: FXS is handset-facing. It is not an FXO gateway for incoming analogue provider lines. Assess cable condition, signalling, PBX interoperability, port count, provisioning and power. No line service or PBX licence is implied.
compatibility.sw: FXS ni upande wa simu za analogue. Si gateway ya FXO ya laini za mtoa huduma. Tathmini nyaya, signalling, compatibility ya PBX, port, provisioning na umeme. Huduma ya laini au leseni ya PBX haidhaniwi kujumuishwa.

name: TA410 · FXO

images.alt: Yeastar TA410 · FXO official manufacturer product photograph

summary.en: Bring suitable analogue outside lines into an IP-PBX design through four FXO ports.
summary.sw: Unganisha laini zinazofaa za analogue kutoka nje kwenye usanifu wa IP-PBX kupitia port nne za FXO.

value.sw: Laini za analogue / PSTN kutoka nje

value.en: External line gateway, not a room-handset adapter
value.sw: Gateway ya laini za nje, si adapta ya simu ya chumbani

variants: Exact revision, firmware, power accessories and licensing confirmed in quotation

compatibility.en: Do not connect ordinary analogue handsets as FXS extensions to FXO ports. Confirm provider line signalling and regional settings, PBX interoperability, power and the actual number of available outside lines. Mobile or SIP trunk service is not included by implication.
compatibility.sw: Usiunganishe simu za kawaida kama extension za FXS kwenye port za FXO. Hakiki signalling ya mtoa huduma, mipangilio ya eneo, PBX, umeme na idadi halisi ya laini. Huduma ya mobile au SIP trunk haidhaniwi kujumuishwa.

name: SIP-T31P

images.alt: Yealink SIP-T31P official manufacturer product photograph

summary.en: A practical two-line SIP desk phone with built-in PoE for appropriately configured office extensions.
summary.sw: Simu ya mezani ya SIP yenye laini mbili na PoE kwa extension za ofisi zilizosanidiwa ipasavyo.

value.sw: PoE imejengwa ndani; adapta ya nje ni chaguo

variants: Exact revision, firmware, power accessories and licensing confirmed in quotation

compatibility.en: Yealink is separate from Yeastar. T31P is not the Gigabit T31G. Verify the PBX supported-device list, exact firmware and provisioning template. Confirm whether an external adapter is needed or supplied; PoE needs a suitable powered switch/injector.
compatibility.sw: Yealink na Yeastar ni watengenezaji tofauti. T31P si T31G ya Gigabit. Hakiki orodha ya PBX, firmware na provisioning template. Thibitisha hitaji na kujumuishwa kwa adapta; PoE inahitaji swichi/injector inayofaa.

name: GRP2602P

images.alt: Grandstream GRP2602P official family reference photograph

summary.en: A PoE-capable GRP2602-series desk phone reference for reception, departments and office extensions.
summary.sw: Rejea ya simu ya mezani ya GRP2602 yenye PoE kwa mapokezi, idara na extension za ofisi.

value.en: GDMS supported; configure for the selected PBX
value.sw: GDMS inaungwa mkono; sanidi kwa PBX iliyochaguliwa
Picha rasmi ya familia ya GRP2602

variants: Exact revision, firmware, power accessories and licensing confirmed in quotation

compatibility.en: The P suffix identifies the PoE variant; do not infer Wi-Fi or Gigabit from this family image. Confirm exact revision, SIP account capacity, firmware and power accessories before ordering. The manufacturer page and older documents differ on account counts, so no account-count promise is made here.
compatibility.sw: Herufi P hutambulisha toleo la PoE; usidhani Wi-Fi au Gigabit kutokana na picha ya familia. Hakiki revision, uwezo wa akaunti za SIP, firmware na adapta kabla ya kuagiza. Ukurasa wa sasa na nyaraka za zamani hutofautiana kuhusu akaunti, hivyo idadi yake haiahidiwi hapa.

name: GHP610

images.alt: Grandstream GHP610 official family reference photograph

summary.en: A compact wired hotel IP phone for guest-room extensions on an appropriately designed PBX system.
summary.sw: Simu ndogo ya IP ya hoteli yenye muunganisho wa waya kwa extension za vyumba kwenye PBX iliyopangwa.

value.en: 100 Mbps Ethernet / PoE on non-W GHP610
value.sw: Ethernet 100 Mbps / PoE kwa GHP610 isiyo W
Simu ya SIP ya chumba cha mgeni
Picha rasmi ya familia ya GHP610/GHP611

variants: Exact revision, firmware, power accessories and licensing confirmed in quotation

compatibility.en: Wi-Fi belongs to W variants, not this wired reference. Verify the exact model, power method and PBX/firmware compatibility. The official family photograph is not proof of stock or exact colour. Wake-up, room status, call billing and PMS functions depend on the compatible PBX/software, integration and licence—not the handset alone.
compatibility.sw: Wi-Fi ni ya matoleo ya W, si rejea hii ya waya. Hakiki modeli, umeme na compatibility ya PBX/firmware. Picha rasmi ya familia haithibitishi stock au rangi. Wake-up, room status, billing na PMS hutegemea PBX/programu, integration na leseni—si simu pekee.
